description: This file is a shell script that defines tests for Git rebase performance, using functions and commands to set up test repositories, perform rebasing operations, and check performance under various configurations.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up a default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for simulating changes.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's internal clock or state.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
